item.description:
VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.94

  • Fixes Companion Realtime Voice HF runtime startup failing with “stt is not defined” when the selected STT profile starts the HF speech-to-speech runtime.
  • Adds a release guard so this undefined-STT startup regression fails packaging checks if it returns.
  • Includes the restored Sparkle Install Update flow from 0.1.93 for signed in-app updates.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.93

  • Restores the in-app Install Update flow to use Sparkle, so signed Companion updates can download, verify, replace the app, and relaunch without requiring the user to manually drag the app from a DMG.
  • Keeps the GitHub release/DMG link available as a manual fallback.

VoiceClaw Companion 0.1.92

  • Keeps Companion Realtime Voice on the streaming transport instead of silently falling back to the legacy turn-upload recorder after socket errors.
  • Adds streaming transport recovery so the iPhone can reconnect while preserving the live microphone session.
  • Avoids unnecessary HF runtime restarts during routine live settings updates.
  • Tightens Companion Realtime Voice planning so iPhone tools run only for clear phone/app/system actions, preventing spoken-only requests such as counting aloud from being misrouted to Maps.
  • Reports HF runtime startup and websocket failures accurately so setup problems do not appear as a ready voice session.
